title: Butterflies
html:
Description

Butterflies are a passive mob that can be found in different places around the entire Oaklands map, some of them spawn exclusively in these places and others can be found in multiple places.

The only way to catch a Butterfly is by using the Bug Net or the Bug Catcher 3000, which are purchasable in Flora Laura Shop. If successfully caught a butterfly, they will transform into a draggable item and fall to the floor.

Butterflies can be sold in the Resource Hub depending on their type. You can also put them in a Butterfly Cage which are found in 3 different sizes in Flora Laura Shop, the butterflies that are placed inside the cage will start to fly inside it. They can also be equiped as pets, and some will give the player effects while being equiped.

(If you found a different type - please add it here.)
